caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest, primarily colored in shades of brown. The chest is rectangular in shape with a flat lid, and stands on short, broad feet. The front panel of the chest features two central decorative sections, each outlined with a scalloped arch and filled with symmetrical floral motifs, including stylized red, green, and yellow flowers and green leafy vines on a light beige background. Each floral panel appears to show a black vase or urn containing the flowers. The sides and top of the chest are unadorned except for a geometric or floral motif on the top. There is a keyhole with an ornamental escutcheon in the center of the front panel. The chest appears to be placed against a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects present in the drawing.
title: Pa. German Dower Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
